{{Quote|Nobody knows where Revan hid the mask. The clans have each staked out their own territory, hoping it's in their destiny to find that which we all seek.|Veela Ordo describes the search to Revan|<ref name="TOR:R" />}}
In [[3954 BBY]], a '''search''' for [[Mandalore's Mask]] was a mission undertaken by the surviving [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clans, leftover from the [[Mandalorian Wars]], gathered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rekkiad]] to find the ancient ceremonial war mask, Mandalore's Mask. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Canderous Ordo]] journeyed to the planet Rekkiad and joined [[Clan Ordo]] in the search. Revan led the clan into [[Clan Jendri]]'s territory in search of the mask, and narrowed the location down to the [[First Spear|one]] of the [[Twin Spears]], a pair of columns of [[Water/Legends|ice]] several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] tall, with flat plateaus on top. They climbed the spear and when they reached the summit, Revan and Ordo rediscovered and investigated the secret chamber and the [[Dramath the Second's tomb|tomb]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dramath the Second]], and also found the mask inside Dramath's [[Dramath the Second's sarcophagus|sarcophagus]].

Shortly after finding the mask, Ordo's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Veela Ordo]] and five Mandalorians [[Skirmish in Dramath the Second's tomb|ambushed]] Ordo and Revan. The next day Revan told Ordo of what truly started the Mandalorian Wars and asked him to stay behind and protect the Mandalorians and the Republic from the threat of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|They're searching for Mandalore's Mask. They think you hid it somewhere on Rekkiad.''"<br />"''I think they might be right.|Canderous Ordo tells Revan of the ongoing search for Mandalore's Mask|<ref name="TOR:R" />}}
[[File:MandaloreTheUltimateWithWickedGoldFlames-KOTOR15.jpg|thumb|right|130px|Mandalore's Mask]]
In [[3960 BBY]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Darth Malak|Malak]] hid the ancient ceremonial war mask, [[Mandalore's Mask]], in the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dramath the Second]]'s [[Dramath the Second's tomb|tomb]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rekkiad]].<ref name="TOR:R" /> [[3954 BBY|Six]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later<ref name="TERC" /> the surviving [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clans&mdash;left over from their [[Mandalorian Wars|war]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;gathered on Rekkiad to search for the Mask, the key to their honor and power. The redeemed [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Revan, under the alias ''Avner'', and Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Canderous Ordo]] journeyed to Rekkiad to aid [[Clan Ordo]] in the search.<ref name="TOR:R" />

==The search==
{{Main|Skirmish on Rekkiad|Skirmish in Dramath the Second's tomb}}
===Skirmish for Clan Jendri's territory===
{{Dialogue|Canderous Ordo|Welcome to the party! Got any bright ideas?|Revan|Have you tried shooting the pilots?|Veela Ordo|Easier said than done. All we need is a few seconds. Just enough time for us to get into our Basilisks and fire them up.|Revan|I can create a distraction. But you'll have to move fast.|Veela Ordo|Whatever you're thinking, do it. If we don't get to our Basilisks, we don't stand a chance.||attr=Canderous Ordo, Veela Ordo, and Revan devise a strategy to get their pilots to their Basilisks|src=<ref name="TOR:R" />}}
During the search Revan&mdash;led by his memory of when Malak and him were last on Rekkiad&mdash;persuaded Clan Ordo to move into [[Clan Jendri]]'s territory in search of the mask. They set up camp and were [[Skirmish on Rekkiad|attacked]] the next morning. Outnumbering Clan Ordo two to one, Jendri's forces [[Ground warfare/Legends|attacked]] their campsite while their [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] razed the battlefield from above, pinning down the invaders. [[Veela Ordo]], Canderous' [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], led her clan into battle, while Revan deduced Clan Jendri's strategy and created a diversion using his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to attack the Jendri's Basilisks. His diversion allowed six Clan Ordo pilots, including Canderous, to make their way safely to their own Basilisk mounts. Revan managed to damage one of Jendri's Basilisks and [[Death/Legends|slew]] the [[Unidentified Clan Jendri pilot|pilot]] when he flew back around to get a bead on the Jedi Master. During the distraction Canderous and five other pilots of Clan Ordo got their Basilisks into the air and proceeded to attack the remaining Jendri pilots. Quickly realizing that they were outnumbered, the remaining Jendri pilots abandoned the battlefield and the battle was quickly turned into a rout. Some of the remaining Jendri troops broke rank soon after and those that remained were slaughtered by Clan Ordo.<ref name="TOR:R" />

Clan Ordo celebrated their victory late into the night, building a [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] pyre for the fallen, honoring their memories through [[Music/Legends|songs]] and a feast, and grieving for their fallen comrades. The following [[Standard day/Legends|day]] Revan&mdash;led by another memory&mdash;narrowed down the location of the mask to [[First Spear|one]] of the [[Twin Spears]], a pair of columns of [[Water/Legends|ice]] several [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] tall, with flat plateaus on top.<ref name="TOR:R" />

===Skirmish in Dramath the Second's tomb===
{{Quote|We're not here to kill you. Just him.|Veela Ordo tells Canderous of her true intentions to kill Revan|<ref name="TOR:R" />}}
They climbed the spear and when they reached the top, Revan and Ordo found the entrance to the secret chamber and the tomb of the Sith Lord Dramath the Second and investigated the chamber. They found Mandalore's Mask inside [[Dramath the Second's sarcophagus|Dramath's sarcophagus]]. Shortly after finding the mask, Ordo's wife Veela Ordo and five Mandalorians [[Skirmish in Dramath the Second's tomb|ambushed]] him and Revan. Veela revealed that she knew Revan's identity and pleaded to Ordo that he break his loyalty to Revan and reclaim his place in Clan Ordo as their leader, and his rightful place at her side. Ordo stated that he couldn't break his loyalty to Revan and pleaded to Veela and the others to stand down. With neither side backing down, Veela and her Mandalorians opened fire on Revan and Ordo. With no other choice left, Ordo and Revan fought for their lives. After a brief [[Lightfight|firefight]] Revan and Ordo were forced to kill Veela and the five other Mandalorians.<ref name="TOR:R" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Many of the Mandalorians are bitter, and hungry for revenge. Without a new Mandalore, how hard would it be for someone to manipulate them into going into war again? Your people have lost their way, Canderous. You need to help them find it again. The fate of the galaxy could depend on it.''"<br />"''Mandalore has returned. I am Mandalore the Preserver, and I will restore the honor and glory of my people!|Revan asks Canderous to stay behind and protect the Mandalorians and the Galactic Republic|<ref name="TOR:R" />}}
[[File:CanderousHS-KOTOR.jpg|thumb|right|130px|Future Mandalore Canderous Ordo]]
After finding the mask the next day Revan told Ordo about how the Mandalorian Wars truly began and of how an [[Unidentified Sith emissary|emissary]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|hidden Sith Empire]] [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|manipulated]] [[Mandalore the Ultimate]] into invading the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After telling Ordo the story Revan told him that he didn't know the identify of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] nor what he was after, but he did know that the Sith knew the Mandalorian invasion would fail and that the war would destroy the warriors. Ordo speculated that if the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were planing another invasion, they would be forced to come through [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalorian space]] first and that the Sith were trying to get rid of the Mandalorians. Revan agreed that it was possible but also mentioned that the Sith could have been trying to twist the beliefs and culture of the Mandalorians in hopes that they would join them. Revan then asked him to stay behind, become the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|new leader]] of the Mandalorians and protect the remaining Mandalorians and the Republic from the threat of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. After hearing Revan out Ordo donned the mask and proclaimed himself ''Mandalore the Preserver'' and vowed that he would restore honor and glory to his people.<ref name="TOR:R" />

==Behind the scenes==
The search for Mandalore's Mask first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'',<ref name="TOR:R" /> which was released on [[November 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="TERC" />
